title: Beam member engineering request
description: Versioned member and leaf-check wire schemas. Geometry, code applicability and identity are also validated semantically.

elasticModulusMpa.description: Null derives E from the selected material method; resolved E and method are returned.

flange.description: Required for T/L; null for rectangular.

rotationalSpringKnMPerRad.description: Optional rotational support spring; null means none.

jointId.description: Required for a frame joint used by seismic checks.

mappingVerificationId.description: Records the physical section orientation and sign verification example.

items.description: Opening geometry/detail reference; no silent ordinary-beam treatment.

creepCoefficient.description: Null derives creep from the selected validated model and age/humidity inputs.

postFinishIncrementLimitMm.description: Required when checking damage to finishes/partitions.

finishesInstalledAtDays.description: Required for incremental deflection after finishes.

longTerm.description: Required for calculated-long-term; not inferred from ULS loads.

couplerProductId.description: Required for a coupler; includes qualified strength and installation basis.

demand.description: Null for logical or incomplete checks.

capacity.description: Null for logical or incomplete checks.

utilization.description: Null where a ratio is not mathematically meaningful; zero capacity never becomes zero utilisation.

anyOf.description: Method must explicitly cover the retained P/M2/M3 domain; no silent component discard.

interactionMethod.description: Any axial or biaxial action outside selected pure-flexure applicability; Method must explicitly cover the retained P/M2/M3 domain; no silent component discard.

supportEnhancement.description: Selected near-support concentrated-load enhancement; Provide load type, support face, load position/av, load magnitude and rule ID; no UDL enhancement.

anyOf.description: A structural analysis/design basis is required; never set T to zero merely because it is inconvenient.

redistributionBasis.description: Compatibility torsion redistribution selected; A structural analysis/design basis is required; never set T to zero merely because it is inconvenient.

crackMethod.description: Validate against the referenced schema and domain rules.
